Low-level Zwift GET

Source: R/zwift.R
zwift_get.Rd

Low-level Zwift GET

Usage

zwift_get(auth, path, query = list(), parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift"))

zwift_profile(auth, rider_id = "me", ...)

zwift_activities(
  auth,
  rider_id = "me",
  start = 0,
  limit = 20,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift")
)

zwift_activity(auth, activity_id, ...)

zwift_followers(
  auth,
  rider_id = "me",
  start = 0,
  limit = Inf,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift")
)

zwift_followees(
  auth,
  rider_id = "me",
  start = 0,
  limit = Inf,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift")
)

zwift_rideons(auth, rider_id, activity_id, ...)

zwift_give_rideon(auth, rider_id, activity_id)

zwift_event(auth, event_id, ...)

zwift_event_subgroups(auth, event_id, parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift"))

zwift_subgroup_results(
  auth,
  subgroup_id,
  start = 0,
  limit = Inf,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift")
)

zwift_event_results(auth, event_id, ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift"))

zwift_subgroup_entrants(
  auth,
  subgroup_id,
  participation = "signed_up",
  start = 0,
  limit = Inf,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift")
)

zwift_event_entrants(
  auth,
  event_id,
  participation = "signed_up",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zwift")
)

zwift_worlds(auth, ...)

zwift_riders_in_world(auth, world_id = 1, ...)

Arguments

auth

A zwift_auth() handle.

path

Endpoint path, e.g. "/api/profiles/me".

query

Named list of query parameters.

parse

One of "tbl", "json", "resp".

ttl

Cache time-to-live in seconds (0 = off, Inf = permanent).

rider_id

Zwift rider id, or "me".

...

For the typed wrappers, further arguments forwarded to zwift_get() (e.g. parse, ttl).

start, limit

Offset of the first record, and how many records to return (Inf = all). Paging happens automatically.

activity_id

Zwift activity id.

event_id

Zwift event id.

subgroup_id

Event subgroup id (from zwift_event_subgroups()).

participation

Entrant filter passed to the API; "signed_up" is the value verified to work.

world_id

World id (1 = Watopia host world).

Value

A tibble, parsed list, or httr2 response.

Functions

  • zwift_profile(): A rider's profile ("me" or a Zwift id).

  • zwift_activities(): A rider's activities, newest first. limit is the total wanted: values above the server's page size (50) are fetched page by page and bound; limit = Inf fetches the whole history.

  • zwift_activity(): A single activity by id.

  • zwift_followers(): A rider's followers (auto-paged, 200 per request).

  • zwift_followees(): Riders a rider follows (auto-paged, 200 per request).

  • zwift_rideons(): Ride Ons on an activity.

  • zwift_give_rideon(): Give a Ride On (POST). Returns the raw response.

  • zwift_event(): An event by id.

  • zwift_event_subgroups(): An event's subgroups (pens / categories): one row each, with id (the subgroup id used by the results and entrants functions), subgroupLabel (A, B, ...), start time and route.

  • zwift_subgroup_results(): Official Zwift race results for one subgroup, in finishing order (rank), auto-paged (50 per request). Nested objects are flattened: activityData.*, criticalP.*, sensorData.*, profileData.*, scoreHistory.*.

  • zwift_event_results(): Race results for every subgroup of an event, bound into one tibble with a leading subgroup label column.

  • zwift_subgroup_entrants(): Riders signed up to one subgroup (auto-paged).

  • zwift_event_entrants(): Sign-ups for every subgroup of an event, with a leading subgroup label column.

  • zwift_worlds(): List of active worlds.

  • zwift_riders_in_world(): Roster of riders currently in a world. Live position/power is protobuf on /relay/worlds/{id}/players/{id}; this JSON endpoint returns the roster only.
